checks.description: Viewing secrets at the namespace scope can lead to escalation if another service account in that namespace has a higher privileged rolebinding or clusterrolebinding bound.
messages: Role 'everything' shouldn't have access to manage secrets in namespace 'kubyl-trivy'
checks.remediation: Manage namespace secrets are not allowed. Remove resource 'secrets' from role
checks.title: Manage namespace secrets

checks.description: Full control of the resources within a namespace.  In some cluster configurations, this is excessive. In others, this is normal (a gitops deployment operator like flux)
messages: Role 'everything' shouldn't manage all resources at the namespace 'kubyl-trivy'
checks.remediation: Remove '*' from 'rules.resources'. Provide specific list of resources to be managed by role in namespace
checks.title: Manage all resources at the namespace

checks.description: Check whether role permits wildcard verb on wildcard resource
messages: Role permits wildcard verb on wildcard resource
checks.remediation: Create a role which does not permit wildcard verb on wildcard resource
checks.title: No wildcard verb and resource roles
